title: Choosing between the Two Measures of a Hotel Rate Plans Cancellation Charge
content:
Two measures of a cancellation charge stand side by side on a Hotel Rate Plans reservation: the amount measured by share, and the amount measured by nights, which is the booked nightly rate multiplied by the cancellation penalty nights the rate plan booked carries and by the rooms standing on the reservation. Which of them is the amount withheld turns on what the folio already shows and on whether the plan booked sets a penalty in room nights at all.

## The rule

1. Where money has already been returned against a prepayment line posted on the reservation and the rate plan booked sets a cancellation penalty in room nights, the amount measured by share and the amount measured by nights are both worked out and the larger of the two is the amount withheld.
2. Where no money has been returned against a prepayment line posted on the reservation and the rate plan booked sets a cancellation penalty in room nights, the amount measured by share and the amount measured by nights are both worked out and the smaller of the two is the amount withheld.
3. In every other case the amount withheld is the amount measured by share.

## Cancellation penalty nights carried by each plan

| Rate plan | Cancellation penalty, room nights | Sets a penalty in room nights |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 0 | no |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 1 | yes |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 1 | yes |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 1 | yes |
| Member Flex Rate | 1 | yes |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 2 | yes |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 3 | yes |

A plan carrying 0 room nights sets no penalty in room nights, so the third case governs it whatever the folio shows.

## The combinations

| Money already returned against a prepayment line | Plan sets a penalty in room nights | Amount withheld |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | the larger of the two measures |
| no | yes | the smaller of the two measures |
| yes | no | the amount measured by share |
| no | no | the amount measured by share |

## Worked on hypothetical figures

Take a reservation on which the amount measured by share works out at 220.00 USD and the amount measured by nights at 340.00 USD, the plan booked carrying 1 cancellation penalty night.

- Where a payout has already been raised against a prepayment line on that reservation, the larger of the two governs and the amount withheld is 340.00 USD.
- Where no payout stands against any prepayment line, the smaller governs and the amount withheld is 220.00 USD.
- On the Non-Refundable Saver Rate, which carries 0 cancellation penalty nights, the amount withheld is the amount measured by share, 220.00 USD, whether or not a payout stands.
